description: Blockchain analytics firms Arkham and Lookonchain have tracked the movement of Solana tokens stolen during the alleged $6.3 billion Binance hack. The attackers reportedly routed around 81 percent of the stolen SOL through THORChain while converting assets across multiple blockchain networks. Lookonchain traced transactions involving conversions from SOL to USDC, Ether, and Bitcoin. The developments follow the FBI’s attribution of the attack to North Korea-linked hackers.
title: Binance Hackers Route 81 Percent of Stolen Solana Through THORChain

description: WhatsApp is reportedly rolling out Recent Media Suggestions to Android and iOS users. The feature displays the latest photo or video from the device's gallery in chats. Users can disable the functionality through the app's settings. Recent Media Suggestions feature is enabled automatically for eligible users. However, users who do not want media suggestions can turn them off through the app settings.
title: WhatsApp Rolls Out Recent Media Suggestions Feature for Android and iOS Users: Report

description: BGMI Air will launch in India on December 10, 2026. The company says it got more than 14 million pre-registrations on Google Play. The company has also revealed details about its Closed Beta Testing programme, which will give selected players an opportunity to try the game ahead of its official release. Closed Beta Testing will take place from November 20 to 24 across three cities.
title: BGMI Air Set to Launch in India on December 10; Closed Beta Testing to Begin Later This Month

description: Microsoft has outlined several changes to how Windows 11 handles memory and runs applications on PCs with 8GB of RAM. These include keeping more active data in memory, prioritising foreground tasks and reducing resource use across Windows and Microsoft apps. Edge can launch faster, while Teams gets Efficiency Mode by default on supported systems. Widgets will also use less memory when closed, and Edge will put inactive tabs to sleep sooner. The improvements are available through Windows and app updates.
title: Windows 11 PCs With 8GB RAM Get Faster Multitasking, Lower Memory Usage

description: Vivo could launch the Watch GT 2 in India alongside its upcoming X500 smartphone lineup. The smartwatch debuted in China in October 2025 with a 2.07-inch display, heart rate and blood oxygen monitoring, and more than 100 sports modes. It is available in Bluetooth and eSIM variants, with claimed battery life of up to 33 days and 28 days, respectively. Meanwhile, the X500 series has reportedly appeared on the BIS website, with pre-bookings said to have begun at select offline stores.
title: Vivo Watch GT 2 Tipped to Launch in India Alongside X500 Series

description: Xbox has reportedly received multiple offers for Arkane Studios, including Ubisoft. According to a new report, Ubisoft and at least two other gaming companies have bid to acquire the French game developer. Microsoft has not yet come to an agreement with a potential buyer. Arkane could also be sold to its management.
title: Ubisoft Reportedly Bids to Acquire Arkane Studios From Xbox

description: The Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY) launched three new sovereign AI models from two Indian AI labs, namely Soket Labs Technology and Research and ZenteiQ AiTech Innovations. The ministry released Soket AI’s EKA-1 and ZenteiQ’s Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B AI models. Soket claims that its AI model features 26.3 million parameters. It has been trained using 7.5 trillion tokens. On the other hand, ZenteiQ’s Dhīr 2B and Dhīr 5B are open-source AI models that are capable of running on edge devices.
title: MeitY Launches Three New Sovereign AI Models Under the IndiaAI Mission

description: Samsung Galaxy A38 will be equipped with a notably larger battery than its predecessor, according to a report. The handset is said to pack a battery with a rated capacity of 5,882mAh, which could be marketed by the smartphone maker as the typical capacity of 6,000mAh. If this is true, it would be a notable upgrade over the Galaxy A37, which features a 5,000mAh battery. On top of this, the report highlights that the higher-end Samsung Galaxy A58 is also expected to boast a 6,000mAh cell. Further, the Samsung Galaxy A58 is expected to see a price hike, too. It is expected to be launched in March or April 2027 at a starting price of EUR 500 (roughly Rs. 53,000). In India, the Samsung Galaxy A37 is currently listed on the Samsung online store at a starting price of Rs. 46,999 for the base 8GB + 128GB RAM and storage configuration.
title: Samsung Galaxy A38 Will Launch Next Year With a Notable Battery Upgrade, Report Says

description: Oppo announced that ColorOS 17, based on Android 17, is now avalable for the Oppo F35 Pro. The handset was launched in India last month with ColorOS 16.5, which is based on Android 16. The latest software version brings several improvements and new artificial intelligence (AI)-powered features. It claims to improve app launch stability by up to 55 percent.
title: Oppo F35 Pro Gets ColorOS 17 Skin Based on Android 17 in India

description: Motorola’s One series of smartphones could be making a return after the brand launched its last One Ace handset in 2021. The Motorola One Fusion+ was the last One-branded handset to be released in India. Now, a new device tagged as the Motorola One has surfaced on a certification website and benchmarking platform Geekbench.
title: Motorola One Design Revealed in WPC Listing, Geekbench Appearance Hints at Key Specs

description: Following its launch in China and global markets, the Vivo X500 series appears to be inching closer to its India launch. Although the company has yet to announce a launch date, pre-bookings for the handsets are said to have already begun at select offline retail stores. The lineup is expected to include the Vivo X500 Pro and Vivo X500 Pro Max, both of which have surfaced in earlier reports concerning their India availability and pricing.
title: Vivo X500 Series Pre-Bookings Begin in India at Select Retailers, Tipster Claims

description: Memecoins featuring the name and images of Spanish footballer Jesús de Miguel have drawn criticism following his death at the age of 30. Screenshots shared on X showed traders promoting tokens named MIGUEL and Miguel alongside news reports and photographs of the striker. The posts sparked debate over the ethics of profiting from personal tragedies through cryptocurrency speculation. A similar controversy emerged after the September 2025 killing of US conservative activist Charlie Kirk, when tokens bearing his name appeared on Solana.
title: Crypto Traders Face Backlash for Launching Memecoins Using Jesús de Miguel’s Image

description: Apple's latest software betas give developers new ways to connect their apps with Siri AI through App Intents and custom skills. The redesigned Health app adds Insights and Longevity sections, along with a Health Age estimate and movement assessments. Separately, Bloomberg reports that Apple is testing Siri Recap and Live Rewind for newer Apple Watch models. The report also points to a December launch of some Apple Intelligence features in China, including notification summaries, Genmoji and writing tools.
title: Apple Releases iOS 27.3 Beta With New Siri AI Tools for Developers, Health App Update

description: Google has announced that it is turning off access to Gemini, Gemini Notebook, Gemini in Classroom, and Google Search for K-12 student accounts to offer more control to schools on how their pupils are using AI. Moreover, the company announced that it is expanding the availability of the Guided Learning mode to more services. Starting November 3, the Guided Learning tool is available in Google Search, along with Google Classroom, which is a central hub for students and teachers that allows them to “organise” their schoolwork, share assignments, and connect with others.
title: Google Turns Off Gemini AI Access for K-12 Student Accounts, Expands Guided Learning to Search and Classroom

description: Vivo X500 FE is reportedly listed in the IMDA database under model number V2653 and certificate number SER/26/0337. The certification identifies the device as a 5G mobile phone. It is listed with WLAN, Bluetooth and NFC connectivity. It is rumoured to come with a 6.31-inch LTPO AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate. It could run on a Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. It could pack a 6,500mAh battery with support for 90W wired and 40W wireless charging.
title: Vivo X500 FE Reportedly Spotted on IMDA Database, Launch Could Be Near

description: The Realme 17T 5G has surfaced in leaked images. The images show a punch-hole display with slim bezels and a square rear camera module with two horizontal pill-shaped sections. The phone appears to have a narrower bottom bezel than the Realme 16T. It is expected to sit below the Realme 17 Pro and Pro+ in the company's lineup. Realme has yet to share details about its hardware, pricing or India launch plans.
title: Realme 17T 5G Could Launch Soon; Leaked Images Reveal Design

description: Xiaomi has started rolling out the stable HyperOS 4 update to compatible handsets and tablets, the smartphone maker announced on Wednesday. The Xiaomi 17 Ultra will be among the first devices to receive the latest HyperOS version, along with other Xiaomi 17 series and Xiaomi 15 phones. Early November will also see the release of HyperOS 4 to the Poco F8 lineup, Poco X8 series, Poco M8 lineup, and Poco C95 Pro and C85. Phones from Xiaomi’s sub-brand, Redmi, will also get the Xiaomi HyperOS 4 upgrade with Android 17 features in early November. This includes the Redmi Note 17 series, Redmi Note 15 series, Redmi 17 series, and Redmi 15 lineup. Apart from this, the first batch of devices also comprises the Xiaomi Pad 8 series.
title: Xiaomi HyperOS 4 to Start Rolling Out Globally This Month With Android 17 Features, New Design: Full Release Schedule

description: Google is said to be testing a change to its Search interface. According to a report, the Mountain View-based tech giant appears to be making its AI Mode less prominent for some users on Search. The dedicated AI Mode button has reportedly been removed from the Search bar on the web. It is, however, believed to be part of a limited experiment, and the feature itself may remain accessible to other users.
title: Google Reportedly Tests Removing AI Mode Button from Search Bar as a Limited Experiment

description: Bitcoin traded near $77,600 as cryptocurrency markets showed tentative signs of recovery amid uncertainty surrounding the US midterm elections. Investors remain cautious about potential regulatory changes, institutional fund flows, and the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate outlook. The Fear and Greed Index stood at 34, while analysts identified $76,000 as an important downside level and $79,000 as a key recovery threshold.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $77,000 as US Election Uncertainty Keeps Crypto Investors Cautious

description: The Oppo Find X10 Ultra has been the subject of the rumour mill for quite a while now. But it's only recently that leaks have begun surfacing rapidly, and this is perhaps due to the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max debuting in global markets. A tipster has now shed light on the key specifications of the Ultra model. The purported handset could use MediaTek's next-generation Dimensity processor. It is also said to feature a high-resolution display, an advanced periscope camera system, and a large battery.
title: Oppo Find X10 Ultra Tipped to Feature Dimensity 9600 Pro Chip, 8,000mAh Battery

description: Vivo X300 Pro, X300 and X300 FE are receiving the OriginOS 7 update. The Android 17-based update is currently rolling out to select users through Vivo's trial programme. OriginOS 7 brings AI features. It offers a Fluid Motion feature for animations and transitions. The update has a refreshed Origin Design. It also boasts Dynamic Translucent Material and adds Jovi AI to Vivo devices.
title: Vivo X300 Pro, X300, X300 FE Get Android 17-Based OriginOS 7 Update

description: Apple with the help of Samsung and LG is reportedly exploring cost-effective ways to manufacture high-mobility oxide (HMO) backplanes for future OLED displays. A report claims that Apple is considering switching from low-temperature polycrystalline oxide (LTPO), which is currently being used in its iPhone and iPad Pro models.
title: Apple Working With Samsung and LG to Explore Cheaper Ways to Manufacturer MacBook Pro OLED Displays

description: Google has updated its privacy policy, allowing its services to use data from Google Workspace apps to show personalised ads. According to the updated Google Privacy and Terms page, Google will not show personalised ads to users based on content from Workspace apps, like Drive, Gmail, Calendar, and Meet, and Google Photos, unless the user chooses to connect one of the apps with Google services like Search and Gemini. The updated terms of the search giant’s privacy policy came into effect on October 16. The policy previously noted that Google services do not refer to the data stored in the Workspace apps and Google Photos for personalised ads. Hence, the latest change adds the caveat that such information can be utilised to show tailored promotional campaigns based on data stored in connected apps. For example, if a user has connected Google Calendar with Gemini, the AI chatbot will present the results along with personalised ads based on events marked in the app.
title: Google Updates Privacy Policy Allowing Search, Gemini  to Use Gmail and Google Photos Content for Personalised Ads

description: LG Channels has expanded its Indian catalogue with movie and music content from NH Studioz, Eros Innovation and PEN Music. The free, ad-supported service now carries more than 170 channels across entertainment, news, lifestyle, devotional programming and other categories. Viewers can also access regional content in several Indian languages, including Bengali, Tamil and Telugu. LG Channels is available on LG Smart TVs and operates in 37 countries, with a global catalogue of more than 5,000 channels.
title: LG Channels Now Offers Over 170 Free Channels in India With New Movie and Music Additions

description: Bethesda has confirmed the official title of The Elder Scrolls 6. The long-awaited RPG will be called Sentinel. The studio did not announce a release window for the game, but said it would be some time before it was ready to share more details. The Elder Scrolls 6: Sentinel is reportedly more than two years away from launch.
title: Bethesda Confirms The Elder Scrolls 6 Is Called 'Sentinel', Launch Reportedly More Than 2 Years Away

description: Canva is restructuring its business, with the changes affecting more than a fifth of its global workforce. According to the company, its move is in line with adapting to changing technology and slower growth. As part of the overhaul, it will lay off employees, ask some to relocate, and make changes to other roles. Canva says it is also bringing several teams under a single product organisation and increasing in-person collaboration.
title: Canva Cuts 22 Percent of Workforce, Plans Major Shift to Product Teams and Office Work

description: YouTube's latest Android app reportedly includes references to a new social experience called Tamba. Details about Tamba were discovered in version 21.44.534 of the YouTube app for Android. Code in the latest YouTube app suggests features like followers, DMs, group chats, and more. Tamba could be an experimental testing ground for social features.
title: YouTube Reportedly Working on Tamba Social App With Followers, DMs, Group Chats, More

description: OpenAI has integrated ChatGPT Voice into the ChatGPT Finances tool, the company has announced. Users can now talk to the AI chatbot about their finances like they would talk to another human being. They can ask questions about their current financial health, transactions, and savings without having to provide a text input. Users will have to connect their financial accounts to access the features. It also lets users interrupt the chatbot during an answer to ask a follow-up question. This adds to the recent wave of updates that the tool has received. Since its launch, OpenAI has added the Weekly Updates feature to ChatGPT Finances, which provides regular insights about the user’s personal finances.
title: OpenAI Brings ChatGPT Voice Support to Finances for Hands-Free Personal Finance Conversations

description: Google's latest Workspace update brings several changes to its productivity apps. Docs and Drive can now handle Markdown files, while Gmail Live and Docs Live let users search their inboxes and create drafts using voice commands. Google Meet gets speech translation across 63 languages and an updated meeting notes feature. The update also speeds up Microsoft 365 data migration, adds web citations to AI-generated spreadsheet content and expands video generation options in Google Vids.
title: Google Adds Gmail Live, Docs Live and 63-Language Translation to Workspace

description: BitMart founder Sheldon Xia has confirmed that the cryptocurrency exchange suffered a security breach on November 2, with initial findings suggesting the attackers could be linked to the Mercado Bitcoin hack reported on the same day. Blockchain analytics platform Bitquery traced approximately $391,000 in suspicious withdrawals from wallets mostly associated with BitMart, beginning 53 minutes before the larger attack. The exchange has not disclosed its total losses or how the attackers gained access. The incident comes as BitMart prepares to shut down its operations by January 31, 2027.
title: BitMart Reports Breach, Points to Suspects in Mercado Bitcoin Attackers

description: Samsung has been introducing gradual changes to its Galaxy Z Fold models year after year. 2027 is expected to be no different. The Galaxy Z Fold 9 will get similar cameras as the outgoing model, but the Galaxy Z Fold 9 Ultra will get a main camera upgrade according to a new leak.
title: Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 9, Z Fold 9 Ultra Camera Details Leaked Ahead of 2027 Launch

description: Rockstar Games has changed the pre-loading date for Grand Theft Auto 6, bringing it up by two days. GTA 6 will now be available to pre-load starting November 10, nine days before it launches on PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. Rockstar also confirmed that the GTA 6 pre-load file will be 212GB in size depending on the device.
title: Grand Theft Auto 6 Pre-Loading Will Begin November 10; Rockstar Reveals Game Size

description: Poco X8 is the third addition to the company's Poco X8 lineup. The handset recently joined its two siblings, namely the Poco X8 Pro and Poco X8 Pro Max. Positioned as a lower-end mid-range smartphone, the Poco X8 offers an interesting mix of technical specifications and user experience. The handset has a large 9,000mAh battery, which delivers about 9 hours of screen-on time. However, the sub-par performance from its Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 chipset does make it a little less impressive. Moreover, the inconsistent camera performance also pulls down the overall user experience. However, for its price, it is a decent offering.
title: Poco X8 Review: Bets Big on Design, Bigger on Battery

description: The Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 was launched earlier this year as the company’s first wide-folding model. Following its debut, several handsets with similar form factors have made it to the market, including the Xiaomi 18 Fold and the iPhone Duo. The South Korean tech conglomerate has now offered a behind-the-scenes look at how it manufactures the Galaxy Z Fold 8. Samsung also revealed details of the quality checks carried out before the foldable reaches consumers.
title: Samsung Shares Behind-the-Scenes Look at Galaxy Z Fold 8 Manufacturing and Testing

description: Following the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro series and the iPhone Duo in September, Apple’s focus is now expected to shift to the vanilla iPhone 18. The standard model is rumoured to debut early next year as part of the Cupertino-based tech giant’s staggered launch strategy. While Apple has yet to confirm any details, a tipster has hinted at key specifications of the purported handset. The iPhone 18 is tipped to sport a 120Hz OLED display and pack a new-generation chipset under the hood.
title: iPhone 18 Key Specifications Leaked by Tipster Ahead of 2027 Launch; May Get a Price Hike
